about: [race tracks] What the game knows of the UK's circuits beyond the map (World/WorldRideCircuits.h). Names are place names only: no circuit logos, sponsors or series. 'start' and 'sectors' are [lat, lon] on the track; left out, the start line is beside the middle of the pit lane and the sectors are a third and two thirds of the way round. 'corners' are famous corners shaped by hand: [lat, lon, name, bank per cent] (+ the outside higher, - an adverse camber), placed on the track's bends as the game's map has them (world_ride WORLD_RIDE_CIRCUITS lists the bends). A road course ('kind': 'road') is timed by gates on the public road, in order; their places are set on the road (checked against the game's map, Nov 19) and snap to the nearest road within 600 m, a main road first.
